name: NXUSD
oneLiner: NXUSD is a Nereus Finance overcollateralized CDP minted on Avalanche; the token has shown a sustained soft-depeg pattern between $0.95 and $1.01.
collateral: Overcollateralized Nereus Finance lending positions, primarily Avalanche ecosystem crypto collateral
pegMechanism: Borrowed stablecoin minted against overcollateralized deposits in Nereus markets and repaid or liquidated through protocol rules

oracleRisk.summary: Nereus Finance integrated Chainlink Price Feeds on Avalanche and Polygon to calculate NXUSD collateral values, with no stronger failover path documented.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: NXUSD token source exposes owner mint and user burn paths but no direct freeze, blacklist, pause, or seize function. Nereus materials describe DAI among NXUSD collateral, so DAI's freeze exposure resolves upstream.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: NXUSD has a single Avalanche deployment in the reviewed metadata and no sourced bridge, lockbox, or cross-chain route was resolved. Pharos treats this secondary-triage row as single-chain/native.

reserves.name: Nereus overcollateralized crypto positions including DAI collateral

notices.title: Sustained soft depeg
notices.message: NXUSD has shown a sustained soft-depeg pattern, with extended periods between $0.95 and $1.01 on CoinGecko/DefiLlama feeds. Treat collateral classification as advisory rather than live redemption assurance.

mintAuthority.summary: NXUSD is a BoringOwnable CDP stablecoin; mint() is onlyOwner. The owner is a Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 with 2-of-3 threshold on Avalanche — no modules, no guard — that administers the NXUSD token and Nereus CDP parameters.

mintIncidents.summary: A flash-loan manipulation of the AVAX/USDC JLP collateral price let an attacker borrow far more NXUSD than justified by collateral, creating about $500K of NXUSD bad debt.

sources.label: Financial Express - Nereus NXUSD bad debt

controls.label: Nereus NXUSD owner multisig (2/3 Gnosis Safe)
controls.capDescription: NXUSD uses BoringOwnable; mint() rate-limits to 15% of total supply per 24h window.
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 87747113: NXUSD token (0xf14f4ce5...) owner() = 0xdd3de3b819edd3a014fda93868d7dfc873341467; eth_getCode returned CONTRACT (len=344). getOwners() decoded 3 addresses; getThreshold() = 2; masterCopy() = 0xfb1bffc9... (Gnosis Safe L2 1.3.0). getModules() returned empty array; guard storage slot = 0x0. No proxy (EIP-1967 slots zero). NXUSD source (Sourcify) shows mint() is onlyOwner with a 15% per-24h rate limiter.

review.evidence: At Avalanche block 87747113: NXUSD (0xf14f4ce5...) is a non-upgradeable BoringOwnable ERC-20; owner() = Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 at 0xdd3de3b8... with 2-of-3 threshold, owners [0x90bd1ecd..., 0xa91c2397..., 0x8c355e95...], no modules, no guard. Source confirms mint() is onlyOwner with a 15% per-24h supply rate cap. Project pivoted from active lending but the on-chain mint authority remains the 2/3 Safe.
